spiritgiven.comments: We felt Fair-mindedness in the first half was being affected by the translator as we saw in some calls they were not communicating with their player to translate but instead helping in the call itself. After feedback this got corrected and did not happen again in the second half

A couple of players felt constant contact even though we gave constant feedback of this, feeling like this was the way they wanted to play against us. There was one dangerous play that ended on a crash with our player on the end zone. We encourage that the use of legs during stall counts maintains the same line of the body as one of our players got kicked in the hand when trying to get a foot block

Great game in general :) very few calls and great communication and fast resolution in the ones that took place. We highlight their great attitude during the whole match with positive comments to their teammates and towards us as well.
Amazing game :) we encourage your players to keep up the good attitude and emotion through the whole game as it is something to highlight from your team

spiritreceived.comments: Generally a great spirited game with some isolated examples. Hand signals could be used more in the game during calls. There was one player who was quick to say “nonono” when a call was made, but her teammate corrected her :)
Some dangerous plays. Many players not knowing the rules. Almost every contact call was not followed and we had to call violation.

Thank you for the Sunday morning game
Let's get coffee next time 
We appreciate the Fair mindedness with the retracted pick call

Thank you for the game Colombia. 
Pick calls were called to their own advantage, players would catch up too close rather than maintain the buffer they had before the pick call. 
Too much body contact but we should have brought this up earlier. 
Sometimes your players were defensive in their calls and didn't hear or take on our perspective (fair mind).

We appreciate the conversation about our body contact and apologize that we didn’t engage with you in a way that felt respectful. We felt your body contact on the mark created a lot of contact and did not adjust after multiple contact and foul calls. We have a lot of respect for you all as opponents and felt that mostly the game was highly spirited and well fought.
